title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v79
author: Evan Park
description:
Motivation: Add the v79 reporting pipeline for the Benchmark Lab focused on adaptive-batching telemetry and aggregated cost/latency metrics. This PR wires a new Airflow DAG and lightweight aggregation workers into the reporting pipeline, introduces a canonical schema for adaptive-batching events, adds representative workload runner configs, and extends the profiling baselines ingestion path so multi-variant runs are correlated with adaptive-batch metadata.

What changed: - New Airflow DAG: benchmark_lab/adaptive_batching_reporting_v79.py that schedules aggregation jobs and daily rollups - Aggregator service changes (benchmark_lab/aggregator): support for batch-windowed grouping, kv-cache-aware attribution, and quantization-profile tags - New representative runners configs under benchmark_lab/runners/representative_v79.yaml (small-signal and mixed-load variants) - Ingestion adapter updated to accept the new adaptive_batching event schema and translate to existing profiling baselines tables - CI job added to .github/workflows/benchmark-lab.yml to run the reporting DAG in a containerized test harness - Documentation updates: docs/benchmark_lab/adaptive_batching.md with migration notes and sample queries - Tests: unit tests for aggregator grouping, e2e integration harness for the DAG (containerized), small sample dataset for nightly smoke runs

Compatibility & Migration: The ingestion adapter supports both legacy and v79 adaptive-batching events. Existing stored reports are untouched; migration scripts are provided for teams that want to backfill adaptive metadata (scripts/migrations/backfill_adaptive_v79.py).

Performance considerations: The aggregator groups events in a sliding window (default 500ms) to attribute batching effects. We added a toggle in config (ADAPTIVE_BATCHING_GROUP_WINDOW_MS) to tune latency vs aggregation accuracy.

Checklist: - [x] Airflow DAG implemented and tested in local harness - [x] Aggregator unit tests added - [x] Representative runners added - [x] Ingestion adapter backwards-compatible - [x] CI job added and passing - [x] Docs + migration notes added

Related: Linear ENG-1842, ENG-2015. This PR continues the adaptive batching work from earlier v72-v78 reporting updates and consolidates telemetry into the same reporting tables to make historical comparisons straightforward.

Sameer Patel: e2e harness looks good. Did you run the DAG with a realistic load shape? The nightly smoke dataset should include mixed burst patterns to validate adaptive grouping.

Evan Park: Added deterministic boundary unit test (test_boundary_grouping) and updated grouping algorithm to use inclusive start/exclusive end semantics.
Evan Park: Ran e2e load with 3 representative burst shapes; results attached to the PR as artifacts and summarized in CI checks. Nightly smoke dataset was extended to include mixed bursts.
